limitations.requirement: Represent a persistent optional shortcut whose producer and consumers span maps.
limitations.finding: Tuxemon already supports variable_set and not variable_set, and WorldSpec story events already expose actions, but StoryEvent cannot declare conditions.
limitations.resolution: Add a generic conditions list to StoryEvent and serialize it as event conditions without Ashenbell-specific behavior.
limitations.fairness_action: Implement before authoring any variant, re-freeze, and use the resulting engine capability for all methods. R0 receives the same event grammar in its prompt.

limitations.requirement: Render a functionally organized small settlement without mislabeling fences or boulders as houses.
limitations.finding: The frozen prototype atlas contains reviewed four-by-five house tiles, but the generic prop compiler cannot compose them.
limitations.resolution: Add one generic building prop using the existing prototype atlas; the anchor is the lower-left foundation cell and the fixed stamp occupies four columns by five rows.
limitations.fairness_action: Implement before authoring any variant, re-freeze, and expose the identical building stamp and tile IDs to R0.

primitives: generic four-by-five outdoor building stamp using existing tiles

post_generation_findings.finding: The reviewed documentation named botanist, but the active upstream database has no matching template, overworld sprite or combat sheet.
post_generation_findings.fairness_action: Apply the same reference-only substitution to existing scientist in R0, R1 and R2; preserve all raw outputs and record the repair per method.
post_generation_findings.validator_action: Add real database-overlay activation to the build audit; TMX loading alone cannot catch NPC database failures.

post_generation_findings.finding: Per-map reachability and state producer/consumer checks treated traversable char_facing_tile event cells as usable. In the client, directional input moves the player onto such a cell rather than leaving the player beside and facing it.
post_generation_findings.fairness_action: Apply one generic stable-anchor and reachable-adjacent-cell audit to final R0/R1/R2 outputs. Preserve R0/R1 failures without design repair; feed the same evidence into the permitted R2 critic-linked revision.
post_generation_findings.validator_action: Require every player-facing interaction to overlap collision or a spawned NPC and have a reachable cardinal neighbor. Treat a blocked secret as interactable when a reachable cardinal neighbor exists.
